content: Cefadroxil for Oral Suspension, USP is provided in the following formulations: 1. 125 mg per 5 mL Suspension: This formulation contains cefadroxil monohydrate equivalent to 125 mg per 5 mL. It is supplied as a light orange-colored powder that, when reconstituted with water, forms an orange suspension with a characteristic mixed fruit flavor. Packaging: 100 mL bottles (NDC 63304-972-04). 2. 250 mg per 5 mL Suspension: This formulation contains cefadroxil monohydrate equivalent to 250 mg per 5 mL. It is supplied as a light orange-colored powder that, when reconstituted with water, forms an orange suspension with a characteristic mixed fruit flavor. Packaging: 50 mL bottles (NDC 63304-973-03). 100 mL bottles (NDC 63304-973-04). 3. 500 mg per 5 mL Suspension: This formulation contains cefadroxil monohydrate equivalent to 500 mg per 5 mL. It is supplied as a light orange-colored powder that, when reconstituted with water, forms an orange suspension with a characteristic mixed fruit flavor. Packaging: 75 mL bottles (NDC 63304-974-01). 100 mL bottles (NDC 63304-974-04). Storage Instructions for Oral Suspension (Prior to Reconstitution): Store at a temperature of 20–25°C (68–77°F), in accordance with USP Controlled Room Temperature guidelines. DURICEF® (Cefadroxil Monohydrate, USP) Capsules (500 mg): These capsules are opaque, with a maroon and white hard gelatin shell. They are imprinted with PPP and 784 on one end, and DURICEF and 500 mg on the other end. Packaging: Bottles of 50 capsules (N 0430-0780-19). Storage: Store at controlled room temperature, between 15–30°C (59–86°F). DURICEF® Tablets (1 gram): These tablets are white to off-white, oval-shaped, and bisected on the top. They are imprinted with PPP on one side of the bisect and 785 on the other side. Packaging: Bottles of 50 tablets (N 0430-0781-19). Storage: Store at controlled room temperature, between 15–30°C (59–86°F). DURICEF® for Oral Suspension (Orange-Pineapple Flavored): 1. 250 mg per 5 mL Suspension: Packaging: 50 mL bottles (N 0430-2782-15). 100 mL bottles (N 0430-2782-17). 2. 500 mg per 5 mL Suspension: Packaging: 75 mL bottles (N 0430-2783-16). 100 mL bottles (N 0430-2783-17). Storage Instructions for DURICEF® Oral Suspension (Prior to Reconstitution): Store at controlled room temperature, between 15–30°C (59–86°F).
